setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.92840.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 143 min; rated 4.25/5 by 20 [1]
- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.bertha.94218.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 143 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.8474.unknown.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 71 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [3]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.partial.deibert.12751.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 46 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Jerry addressed the audience, noting Bobby had "roses for lunch" during technical issues [9]
- The band performed a quick hint of this song between technical problems [9]
- The Dead played a super long show, though the New Riders likely did not perform [13]
- Bobby started the Weather Report Suite Prelude as the Set 2 tape ran out [1]
- The reviewer considered this their apex show until 1977, despite others praising August 27, 1972 [9]
- The reviewer thinks this show is superior to the highly praised August 27, 1972 Veneta performance [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.92840.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Rob Eaton lent the Dats recorder used to capture this specific song [1]
- **gd1972-08-25.sbd.miller.bertha.94218.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>FLAC>>DAW(Bertha)>>Audio DVD>>FLAC [2]. Also: Digitally remastered in 2008 using the Bertha Digital Audio Workstation by an archive.org user [2]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.8474.unknown.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Partial Set 1 lineage: SBD to MR to PCM to DAT [3]
- **gd72-08-25.sbd.partial.deibert.12751.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Jace's tape transferred via 7" Betty Board Reel to Fostex D5 optical S/PDIF out; Tim Deibert captured the audio to disk, with some Soundforge editing applied [4]
